# Runebender

Runebender is an experimental open-source font editor for UFO and Designspace sources.
The native editor runs on macOS and Linux; the browser demo edits a bundled font in memory.
Documentation: https://runebender.org/docs
Source: https://github.com/eliheuer/runebender-xilem

## If an agent was given only runebender.org

Read the page matching the task below, then read the font project's own `DESIGN.md` or the editor repository's `AGENTS.md` when available.
For live work, connect to the intended native editor and use MCP `tools/list` for exact schemas.
Do not infer a font's design rules from this website.

## Task map

- Install or run: https://runebender.org/docs/install.html
- Open, edit, and save fonts: https://runebender.org/docs/opening.html
- Find an editor feature: https://runebender.org/docs
- Connect an agent to unsaved native work: https://runebender.org/docs/mcp.html
- Choose an agent workflow: https://runebender.org/docs/agents.html
- Make or share a theme: https://runebender.org/docs/themes.html
- Locate or change code: https://runebender.org/docs/architecture.html
- Follow interface design rules: https://runebender.org/docs/design-principles.html
- Understand UFO and Designspace preservation: https://runebender.org/docs/source-format-allowlist.html
- Check current boundaries: https://runebender.org/docs/known-limitations.html
- Read the complete manual in one fetch: https://runebender.org/llms-full.txt
- Read a machine-readable capability summary: https://runebender.org/agent-capabilities.json

## Live work

The repository root `.mcp.json` registers `runebender mcp --live`; clients can also register that stdio command themselves.
List `editor_sessions`, connect to the font the user named, and confirm the source and document epoch before reading or editing.
Receipt-backed `agent_apply` uses explicit authorization, identities, revisions, and an operation key; `agent_receipt` reconciles an uncertain response.
Saving remains a separate action.
A successful proof transport is not proof that a model inspected the image.
The browser demo and Windows do not expose the native Unix live endpoint.
